candidate_class: all actual real targets; bounded status checked additionally
inputs: all three-path and four-path length-three masks; positive, mixed and asymmetric target factors; four prescribed queries each; three glued-mask controls
solver_input: public mask, query, both gradients and loss; hidden factors excluded
gradient_count_audit: single-block inputs only; glued controls audit the full norm-augmented system
execution: serial fresh Python subprocess per case; no cross-solver timing ranking
checkpoint: write and hash-bind the exact norm-list certificate before the ancillary gradient-fiber audit; a later timeout is retained as a timeout
reference_scope: rational-point norm ideals are certified; non-point or non-shape cases remain unresolved
retention: all inputs, timeouts, unresolved cases and negative controls retained
